title: The Two Bricks Left
summary: Nasruddin was building a brick wall in his garden. After working all day, he found he had exactly two bricks left over....
full_text:
Nasruddin was building a brick wall in his garden. After working all day, he found he had exactly two bricks left over.

He spent three hours measuring, digging, and recalculating where to place the two extra bricks.

Finally, his wife called out: "Husband, just toss the two bricks into the garden corner!"

Nasruddin wiped his forehead in admiration: "How marvelous is woman's intellect! I have studied Euclidean geometry for forty years, yet she solved the crisis in two seconds!"
moral: Complicated architectural schemes often stumble over the simplest arithmetic.
